newsitem.title: GERMANY: NCO found dead on eve of court-martial in Germany.
newsitem.headline: NCO found dead on eve of court-martial in Germany.

text.p: A U.S. Air Force mechanic based in Germany, who was due to face a court-martial on Friday over a fatal 1995 plane crash, was found dead with a gunshot wound to his head late on Thursday, air force officials said.

Technical Sergeant Thomas Mueller, assigned to the 52nd Equipment Maintenance Squadron at Spangdahlem airbase, was found outside the base and taken to hospital in the western town of Bitburg where he was pronounced dead.
When asked if Mueller's death looked like suicide, an air force spokesman said: "He was found dead with a gunshot to his head. So you can draw your conclusions from that."
Air force officials said in a statement that the death was under investigation.

Mueller faced charges along with Technical Sergeant William Campbell of negligent homicide and dereliction of duty over the death of air force pilot Major Donald Lowry in the May 1995 crash of an F-15 plane, the U.S. forces newspaper Stars and Stripes reported.
